_comment: A1: original HF endpoint, effective batch 256 (single step, no accumulation), same 15-epoch cosine and same 4500 sample exposure target.

ablation.name: A1_hf_b256
ablation.notes: Batch-256 counterpart of A0 with a true single 256 forward (no accumulation). Enabled by the recomputed ReLU2 attention path (model.attn_relu2_impl=recomputed): legacy peaked at 14.75GB / 7.8s per step at mb256, recomputed at 4.44GB / 1.0s. 4500/256 = 17 optimizer steps per epoch, so epoch 4 lands at step 68.
